notes: The site has no per-item translations (translationsEnabled=false); instead it has three separate menu sections (English, عربي, کوردی). Each category/item carries only the language of its section; sections are not item-aligned (different counts, order and prices), so they were not merged.
'available': false = product is_active=false on the site (hidden from the public menu; many have placeholder prices such as 1 or 3).
Variant 'extra' is the option's surcharge as stored by the site; 'price' = item price + extra.
Categories with id '<lang>-all' hold products attached directly to a top-level section (no sub-category); the site lists them under /all/ and the name is the section name.
Description language key is 'en' when the text is Latin script, otherwise the section's language.
